primitives.verbatim_quote: Two surfaces coexist and most components choose with a `variant` prop: - **dark** (the product's default ground): put the page on `bg-carbon text-ion`, cards on `bg-eclipse border border-mineral`, elevated chrome on `bg-titanium`.

Color tokens act as a shared vocabulary for visual semantics, enabling consistent styling across components. Failure modes arise when variant mismatches occur or when CSS variables are undefined, leading to visual regressions.
